title: Workflows
subtitle: Recoverable multi-step orchestration: resume, revision import, gated retries

start.title: Create workflow
start.resumeOf: Revision source run_id (optional: completed steps with identical input are imported)
start.help: Define steps and dependencies. Steps in the same layer can run in parallel. Validate before starting; tool calls follow the system approval rules.
start.exampleResearch: Research the topic and produce verifiable findings
start.exampleSummary: Summarize upstream results with conclusions and evidence
start.placeholder: Paste a workflow JSON specification or start with the example

detail.empty: Select a run to view details
detail.loadFailed: Failed to load — the run may have been cleaned up or no longer exists

toast.revisionHint: Revision source {{id}} filled — edit the spec and start to import completed steps

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.select: Select a workflow to view its definition
definitions.help: Save reusable steps and dependencies, then start them separately. Saving and editing do not execute the workflow.
definitions.deleteMessage: Delete the definition "{{name}}"? Existing runs and their history will be kept.
definitions.saved: Saved as a reusable definition. View and start it in Definitions.

cleanup.title: Clean up history
cleanup.days: Days to keep (0 clears all history)
cleanup.includeStopped: Include stopped runs (they can no longer be resumed)
cleanup.help: Permanently delete matching runs, step results and events. By default, only completed and failed runs are removed. Active runs and sources needed by running or resumable revisions are kept. Definitions are unaffected.
cleanup.deleteMessage: Permanently delete this run of "{{name}}", its step results and events? It can no longer be resumed or imported. The workflow definition is unaffected.
